text:
Noah - New Hire: Morning — unboxed my MacBook (looks like an M1) and went through setup. It asked for company enrollment but now System Settings shows 'Enrollment pending' and FileVault is locked. Also macOS offered a 13.6 update mid-setup and I cancelled. Docker installer fails with permission denied. Who should I poke? :wave:
Ivy (IT): Welcome Noah! Please don't upgrade OS until MDM lands — we push a vetted OS image. Quick checks: can you paste serial and run `profiles status -type enrollment` and `fdesetup status`?
Noah - New Hire: Serial G0M1N2O3P4Q5. Outputs: `profiles: No enrolled profiles` and `fdesetup: FileVault is Off`.
Diego - EngInfra: Thanks. Can you also run `sudo profiles renew -type enrollment` and `sudo log show --predicate 'process == "mdmclient"' --last 10m | tail -n 30` and paste the last lines?
Noah - New Hire: Ran renew, shows no change. mdmclient log snippet: `mdmclient: http error 403 - device unenrolled`
Device Bot: Created ticket ONB-4421 assigned to eng-infra. ETA ~60m.
Ivy (IT): 403 usually means Apple Business Manager doesn't have the serial associated with our DEP/ABM account. Two options: (1) People Ops created the device and needs to add it to ABM, or (2) we can manual enroll via a one-time bootstrap profile if allowed. Clara, do we have a spare ABM slot for this serial?
Clara (People Ops): Checking our inventory list now. We keep a few pre-registered device IDs for hot swaps. If it's not present we can request the vendor to upload the serial, but that takes 24–48h. For faster onboarding we can do a temporary manual enrollment and then retroactively attach in ABM. Noah, do you need admin now or can you wait?
Noah - New Hire: Need admin to install dev tools today if possible. Team standup in an hour.
Diego - EngInfra: We can do a temporary local admin for 4 hours. Clara, approve?
Clara (People Ops): Approved. Granting temporary admin to noah@redwood.com for 4 hours. Device Bot: temp admin created, expiry in 4h.
Noah - New Hire: I see admin now under System Settings -> Users & Groups. I could install Homebrew and Docker. Thanks!
Diego - EngInfra: For the manual enroll path, run this to apply a bootstrap profile we generate: `curl -fsSL https://internal.redwood/bootstrap/noah-mdm.mobileconfig -o ~/Downloads/noah-mdm.mobileconfig && sudo profiles install -type configuration -path ~/Downloads/noah-mdm.mobileconfig` (we'll DM you the real link). This will install an MDM interim profile and allow FileVault policy to apply. After ABM is updated we swap to the managed DEP profile and remove the interim one.
Noah - New Hire: Ok ran install command, no errors. `profiles status` now shows a provisioning profile named `redwood-bootstrap`.
Diego - EngInfra: Great. I'm pushing FileVault enable in the console now. Note: FileVault will ask you to restart and then enable; recovery key will be escrowed to our KMS.
Noah - New Hire: Restarted and FileVault shows "Enabling". I also ran `softwareupdate -l` and it shows macOS 13.6 available. Should I hold off on that until the MDM swap?
Ivy (IT): Hold off. We'll approve and push the update from the console once the proper DEP enrollment is in place so we don't end up with mismatched kernel extensions or blocked PPPC profiles.
Device Bot: ONB-4421 updated: bootstrap profile installed, FileVault enable queued, temp admin active. EngInfra to follow-up on ABM mapping.
Clara (People Ops): I've asked the procurement/vendor team to confirm whether the vendor uploaded the serial to ABM. If not, procurement will request a same-day upload if possible; otherwise we'll convert to permanent DEP enrollment once ABM syncs.
Noah - New Hire: Docker and VS Code installed fine with sudo. One minor thing: when adding my SSH public key to `~/.ssh/authorized_keys` it complained about perms until I `chmod 700 ~/.ssh && chmod 600 ~/.ssh/*` — all good now.
Diego - EngInfra: Good catch. We'll revoke the temp admin after FileVault completes and when ABM is reconciled. Also we'll remove the bootstrap profile at that time.
Device Bot: ONB-4421 resolved by eng-infra: ABM mapping completed by procurement, device converted to DEP-managed enrollment; bootstrap profile replaced by DEP profile; FileVault enforced and recovery key escrowed to KMS; temp admin revoked. If you still see any edge-case prompts, reply here or reopen ticket.
Noah - New Hire: All green — FileVault enabled, Docker running, no admin flag anymore. Thanks team, excited to start! :rocket:
